en.io: Input: learner-authored LEARNING-SPEC.md, fetched official Pipecat documentation, provider and transport choices, and a test prompt. Output: a .claude/skills/pipecat skill and example pipeline skeletons.
en.boundary: This evidence is a lesson, not the completed Pipecat skill or official API documentation. Example imports and historical claims may become outdated; executable code must be checked against current official docs and installed versions.
dependencies: A Context7 documentation-fetching skill or equivalent
Pipecat and selected provider packages for running generated examples
scenarios: Create a local Pipecat skill from official documentation.
Test provider, processor, pipeline, transport, and speech-to-speech patterns.
